title: Kelly Q Probable NDE 6951
content: When I felt my heart stop, I was instantly outside my body. My consciousness it seems, was in a different dimension. It seems I was made of particles, something that may be described better with quantum physics. I was entirely outside of space and time where everything was simultaneous. I was made privy to a record including everything that has ever happened and everything that ever will happen in the future. I found myself in a playground of sorts. I perceived it to be in the future. It was a huge indoor playground with very high ceilings: very advanced children around the ages of 3 and 5. We were playing on electric-powered tricycles with buttons for forward and reverse. They were riding on little tracks with curves, hills, and valleys for them to go around, up and down. I no longer felt pleasure, pain, hot, or cold. All physical sensations were gone my consciousness was no longer limited by its biological housing we call the brain. There was definitely communication between myself and a power greater than me. After asking for forgiveness, I realized I was not ready to be judged and reborn, which I believe was possible. I begged and pleaded to return to this life and my body so that I may continue living now. At this point, I coughed the respirator out, and I awoke in a specialty hospital. I had been unconscious 3 days. It only seemed like hours had passed. I came back frustrated that I could not bring back the knowledge that I was aware of during my experience. Very soon, I realized I did not come back empty handed I returned with gifts. I remembered things that I learned in school that I did not remember before. I have a newfound compassion for every living soul and understanding for people. I also gained the power of discernment of spirits. As I look in people’s eyes, I can see their intentions. I see their love, their hate, their pain, and their desires. I hear these things in their voices, as well. This can be uncomfortable and awkward at times; if someone is lying to me, I will tell them to turn away from me and walk away. They say Kelly why are you being so rude to me and I tell them I'm not. I asked them, ‘why are you lying to me?’ People don't get it; they just don't or cannot understand. Every living thing to me is so precious now. I was biology major in college so I already logged life but now I cherish and value every living thing so much. It’s like Walt Whitman said ‘to me every hour of the day and night is an unspeakably perfect miracle’.

arrival.other_being_detail: Communication with a "power greater than me."

environment.environment_other_detail: A huge indoor playground with very high ceilings; electric-powered tricycles on tracks with curves, hills, and valleys; perceived to be in the future.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Begged and pleaded to return to continue living in this life; felt not ready to be judged and reborn.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Coughed the respirator out and awoke in the hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Access to a record of everything that has happened and will happen; perceived future playground setting; loss of physical sensations; possible judgment/rebirth mentioned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate OBE after heart stopped, then being outside space/time with simultaneous perception and access to a record of all events, then an indoor playground environment with advanced children, then communication with a greater power, then pleading to return and awakening in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described self as made of particles ("quantum physics" framing); perceived a future indoor playground with advanced children using electric-powered tricycles on tracks; mentioned not being ready to be "judged and reborn" and believing rebirth was possible; returned with enhanced memory and "discernment of spirits" (seeing intentions in eyes/voices).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was entirely outside of space and time where everything was simultaneous.”; “I was made privy to a record including everything that has ever happened and everything that ever will happen in the future.”; “There was definitely communication between myself and a power greater than me.”; “I realized I was not ready to be judged and reborn, which I believe was possible.”; “I came back frustrated that I could not bring back the knowledge…”; “I also gained the power of discernment of spirits.”; “to me every hour of the day and night is an unspeakably perfect miracle”.
